s2.ptxt: Clean Side Mudguard Double-sided Tape Installation Surface

s3.ptxt: Using an infrared lamp, etc., warm the double-sided tape remaining on the side mudguard.
While it is warmed with an infrared lamp, etc., rub off the double-sided tape remaining on the side mudguard with a shop rag, etc.

item.ptxt: Installing the side mudguard with double-sided tape remaining may cause poor adhesion, so remove it completely.
Removing it with a screwdriver, etc. will cause scratches and poor adhesion, so rub it off with a shop rag, etc.
